obligations.source_text: For one independent randomized complex test arm, depict an original adult fictional woman as a clearly legible maritime police or coast guard professional during dawn storm-debris recovery around a disabled sailboat, using the attached portrait only as visible facial and hair appearance guidance.

bindings.maritime_duty_uniform_phrase: the adult coast-guard responder wears a coherent deck-duty uniform of a high-visibility waterproof flotation jacket over dark operational layers
bindings.flotation_radio_system_phrase: lifejacket radio gloves and deck footwear form one system
bindings.rescue_appliance_action_phrase: pays out a rescue line toward the marked target
bindings.water_target_relation_phrase: the line remains connected from rescuer to water target
bindings.controlled_recovery_phrase: recovery route leads toward the rescue boat rail
